title: Are We Overthinking One-Step Generation?
abstract: arXiv:2610.20331v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion and flow matching are now dominant frameworks for generative modeling in continuous domains, but they typically require multiple network evaluations at inference. This has motivated extensive research on one-step generative modeling primarily built on diffusion and flow, though existing approaches often rely on complex training machinery. In this work, we introduce Priming Models, a simple two-stage framework for training one-step generators. Motivated by the difficulty of distributional training from scratch, Priming Models are first trained on a reconstruction objective, e.g., pixel-space denoising at a fixed noise level, before undergoing feature-space distributional post-training. Our central scientific finding is that this simple reconstruction stage is already enough to entirely alleviate the difficulty of distributional training. Empirically, across class-conditional image generation, text-to-image generation, and world

translated_title: 我们是否把单步生成想得太复杂了？
translated_abstract: 扩散模型和流匹配如今已成为连续域生成建模的主流框架，但它们在推理时通常需要多次网络评估。这推动了大量基于扩散和流的单步生成建模研究，然而现有方法往往依赖复杂的训练机制。在本工作中，我们提出了Priming Models（预启动模型），这是一个用于训练单步生成器的简单两阶段框架。鉴于从零开始进行分布训练的困难，Priming Models首先以重建目标进行训练（例如在固定噪声水平下进行像素空间去噪），然后再进行特征空间的分布后训练。我们的核心科学发现是：这一简单的重建阶段本身就足以完全消除分布训练的困难。实证结果表明，该方法在类条件图像生成、文本到图像生成和世界模型等任务上均有效。
tldr: 本文提出Priming Models两阶段框架：先用简单的重建目标（如固定噪声水平的像素去噪）预训练，再进行特征空间分布后训练，并发现这一简单的重建阶段即可完全解决单步生成器分布训练的困难。
